hooks.logic:
If the current form of the enemy is "3" and (count up "currentTurn", then the count "currentTurn" is more than the numeric entry "turn_to_protect" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy), then
  The enemy changes to form "4".
  The enemy cancels its cast.
  The enemy uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: [[{deformTag: "deformation_01"}]]} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
  Choose state 12 next and stop.
Let paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs be the form for the enemy under the phases list.
If paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs is not the current form of the enemy, then
  The enemy changes to form paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs.
  The enemy cancels its cast.
If the enemy is ready to act, then the enemy picks and uses a smart-weighted move.

hooks.logic:
Let resultObjectsInFrame be the results "damage" this frame.
If the length of resultObjectsInFrame is more than 0, then
  For each x in resultObjectsInFrame, add x's 'damage' to the register's 'totalDamage'.
If the register's 'totalDamage' is at least the numeric entry "damage_amount_to_normal" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy, then
  The enemy changes to form "3".
  The enemy cancels its cast.
  Reset the count "currentTurn".
  Set the register's 'totalDamage' to 0.
  The enemy uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: [[{deformTag: "deformation_02"}]]} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
  Choose state 11 next and stop.
If the enemy is ready to act, then the enemy picks and uses a smart-weighted move.
